scope: Forensic reconstruction only of the exact five original custom outer forests. No new candidate, tuning, inner/full fit, thresholds, labels, evaluation selection, application changes, or deployment. Interpret paths only after all 3724 saved minimum-window outer scores match within 1e-12.
exact_fit: experiment.py custom fit using outer fold salt mute-optimization-v1-outer, same sorted group order, eligible-row weights 1/eligible_windows_per_move and split class cost5; 64 whole-group bootstrap trees each seeded SeedSequence([20261103,20,fold,tree_number]); exact original Tree AST.
trace_definition: Each traversed split contributes child.raw_p-parent.support.raw_p, summed by base feature including missing indicator, averaged across 64 trees; add average root raw_p for exact score identity. Raw p is unweighted bootstrap-window positive proportion. Current is limiting on score ties. Summaries are path associations, not causal influence.
